events.summary: Jadepeak Power Electronics (SUP-0013) customer notice CN-2026-09, dated 18 September 2026, is a slip notice, not a rename or closure. It puts the JPD300, JPD150, JPD60, JPA1000 and JPA240 families on allocation because of a high-voltage MLCC and power inductor shortage, and says orders placed after 1 October 2026 carry a 16-week lead time (up from 8), with allocation by trailing 12-month purchases. It moves five open lines: HPO-26-00486/10 JPD300-48S24 555 pcs from 2026-09-21 to 2026-11-09; HPO-26-00517/20 JPD60-48S05 810 from 2026-09-23 to 2026-11-04; HPO-26-00517/10 JPD150-48S12 630 from 2026-09-30 to 2026-11-11; HPO-26-00672/10 JPD300-48S24 445 from 2026-11-20 to 2027-01-08; HPO-26-00646/10 JPA1000-48D 85 from 2026-11-23 to 2027-01-04. The notice's allocation share for Halden and the new lead time for future orders are not quantified in the records, so the buyer must confirm them with Jadepeak.

recommendation.finding: Jadepeak's notice of 18 September is a real supply warning, not a rename or a closure. It puts five power-module families (DC-DC and AC-DC) on allocation because of a high-voltage capacitor and power inductor shortage. It also pushes out five open order lines, with the new promise dates running into November and January, and it lengthens lead time on new orders. Jadepeak is on file as one company with one record, so there is nothing to link and nothing to stage. Next step: Dana Reyes or whichever buyer owns these module lines should confirm Halden's allocation share and the new lead time with the Jadepeak contact on file, then check the two JPD300 and JPD60 slips against the build month.
assumptions: Stock on hand is unknown, so any shortage from the slipped lines is short unless there is stock.
The buyer for these module lines is not confirmed in the records, so the owner of the next step is unconfirmed.
would_change: Jadepeak's written allocation share for Halden and the new lead time for future orders
A confirmed origin and tariff code per model, since Jadepeak says some are made in Taiwan and some in China
